label: Central open-to-sky courtyard
rationale: A 23200 x 8900 mm open-to-sky court sits at the centre of the plan, ringed by a continuous corridor loop: runs down its east and west faces and full-width runs across its north and south faces, which close the loop so either stair/lift block is reachable from every flat. The dwellings form an outer ring in the north and south wings, so the circulation and the inner face of each flat draw daylight and cross air from the court as well as from the outer facade. The court consumes built area and the loop lengthens the circulation perimeter, which is the trade this organization makes.
rankingExplanation: Ranked higher because, on the priorities this brief emphasized, it is privacy separation better by 6 points (bedrooms average 12.1 m from common circulation; 0 of 8 share a wall with it).
